title: Probing Monitor-Evasion Awareness in Small LLMs

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Directly addresses whether small models can evade monitors, which is critical for the entire AI control paradigm. If small models can systematically evade, the control stack must be fundamentally rethought. High-impact finding either way.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires fine-tuning a 7B model to be 'monitor-aware,' which demands significant ML engineering skill, understanding of fine-tuning procedures, and constructing appropriate training data. Beyond typical beginner capability even with medium compute.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two major tasks: fine-tuning a model for monitor-awareness AND building a monitor-evasion evaluation pipeline. Fine-tuning alone could consume the 30-hour budget. Scope is too broad.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
